drug_classes.name: Biguanide
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces hepatic gluconeogenesis and improves insulin sensitivity
drug_classes.target: AMPK-linked metabolic pathways / hepatic glucose output

drug_classes.name: SGLT2 inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces renal glucose reabsorption, producing glucosuria and natriuresis

drug_classes.name: GLP-1 receptor agonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Enhances glucose-dependent insulin secretion, suppresses glucagon, slows gastric emptying and increases satiety

drug_classes.name: Dual GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Activates GIP and GLP-1 receptors to improve glucose-dependent insulin secretion and satiety

drug_classes.name: DPP-4 inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Prolongs endogenous incretin activity, increasing glucose-dependent insulin release and reducing glucagon

drug_classes.name: Sulfonylurea
drug_classes.mechanism: Closes beta-cell ATP-sensitive potassium channels and stimulates insulin release

drug_classes.name: Thiazolidinedione
drug_classes.mechanism: Activates PPAR-gamma to improve peripheral insulin sensitivity

drug_classes.name: Alpha-glucosidase inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Delays intestinal carbohydrate digestion and post-prandial glucose absorption

drug_classes.name: Meglitinide
drug_classes.mechanism: Short-acting beta-cell potassium-channel closure causing meal-time insulin release

drug_classes.name: Basal insulin
drug_classes.mechanism: Provides sustained insulin receptor activation to suppress hepatic glucose output and support basal glucose disposal

drug_classes.name: Prandial insulin
drug_classes.mechanism: Rapid/short insulin receptor activation covering meal-related glucose rise

drug_classes.name: Thyroid hormone replacement
drug_classes.mechanism: Replaces T4 and restores thyroid-hormone signaling
drug_classes.target: Nuclear thyroid hormone receptors after T4→T3 conversion

drug_classes.name: Thionamide antithyroid drug
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits thyroid peroxidase-mediated hormone synthesis

drug_classes.name: Systemic glucocorticoid
drug_classes.mechanism: Modulates glucocorticoid receptor transcription to suppress inflammation

drug_classes.name: Vitamin D therapy
drug_classes.mechanism: Restores vitamin D signaling and calcium/phosphate homeostasis

drug_classes.name: Calcium supplement
drug_classes.mechanism: Provides elemental calcium for replacement/supplementation

drug_classes.name: ACE inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces angiotensin II formation and aldosterone signaling

drug_classes.name: Angiotensin receptor blocker (ARB)
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks angiotensin II AT1 receptor

drug_classes.name: Angiotensin receptor–neprilysin inhibitor (ARNI)
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks AT1 receptor and inhibits neprilysin, augmenting natriuretic peptides

drug_classes.name: Dihydropyridine calcium-channel blocker
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces vascular smooth-muscle calcium influx and vasoconstriction

drug_classes.name: Non-dihydropyridine calcium-channel blocker
drug_classes.mechanism: Slows AV nodal conduction and reduces myocardial/vascular calcium influx

drug_classes.name: Thiazide/thiazide-like diuretic
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits sodium-chloride reabsorption in distal convoluted tubule

drug_classes.name: Loop diuretic
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits Na-K-2Cl cotransport in thick ascending limb, producing potent natriuresis

drug_classes.name: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks aldosterone receptor effects on sodium retention and remodeling

drug_classes.name: Beta-adrenergic blocker
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces sympathetic beta-receptor signaling, heart rate and renin release

drug_classes.name: Alpha-1 adrenergic blocker
drug_classes.mechanism: Relaxes vascular and prostatic smooth muscle

drug_classes.name: Central alpha-2 agonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces central sympathetic outflow

drug_classes.name: Direct vasodilator
drug_classes.mechanism: Directly relaxes arteriolar smooth muscle

drug_classes.name: Organic nitrate
drug_classes.mechanism: Generates nitric oxide, increasing cGMP and venodilation/coronary vasodilation

drug_classes.name: Late sodium-current inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces late inward sodium current and diastolic wall tension

drug_classes.name: Funny-current (If) inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Slows sinoatrial pacemaker current without direct inotropy reduction

drug_classes.name: Aspirin antiplatelet
drug_classes.mechanism: Irreversibly inhibits platelet COX-1 and thromboxane A2 formation

drug_classes.name: P2Y12 inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks ADP-mediated platelet activation

drug_classes.name: Direct factor Xa inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Directly inhibits activated factor X and thrombin generation

drug_classes.name: Direct thrombin inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Directly inhibits thrombin activity

drug_classes.name: Vitamin K antagonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces synthesis of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors

drug_classes.name: Low-molecular-weight heparin
drug_classes.mechanism: Potentiates antithrombin with predominant factor Xa inhibition

drug_classes.name: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin)
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces hepatic cholesterol synthesis and increases LDL receptor expression

drug_classes.name: Cholesterol absorption inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces intestinal cholesterol uptake

drug_classes.name: PCSK9 inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Prevents LDL-receptor degradation, increasing hepatic LDL clearance

drug_classes.name: Fibrate
drug_classes.mechanism: Activates PPAR-alpha to reduce triglycerides and alter lipoprotein metabolism

drug_classes.name: Cardiac glycoside
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits Na/K ATPase and increases vagal AV-nodal effects

drug_classes.name: Class Ic antiarrhythmic
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks fast cardiac sodium channels and slows conduction

drug_classes.name: Class III antiarrhythmic
drug_classes.mechanism: Prolongs cardiac repolarization; individual agents have additional channel/receptor effects

drug_classes.name: Short-acting beta2 agonist (SABA)
drug_classes.mechanism: Rapid bronchodilation through airway beta2-receptor activation

drug_classes.name: Long-acting beta2 agonist (LABA)
drug_classes.mechanism: Sustained beta2-mediated bronchodilation

drug_classes.name: Short-acting muscarinic antagonist (SAMA)
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks airway muscarinic bronchoconstrictor tone

drug_classes.name: Long-acting muscarinic antagonist (LAMA)
drug_classes.mechanism: Sustained blockade of airway muscarinic bronchoconstriction

drug_classes.name: Inhaled corticosteroid (ICS)
drug_classes.mechanism: Suppresses airway inflammation through glucocorticoid-receptor transcriptional effects

drug_classes.name: ICS/LABA combination
drug_classes.mechanism: Combines anti-inflammatory corticosteroid with long-acting bronchodilation

drug_classes.name: ICS/LABA/LAMA triple inhaler
drug_classes.mechanism: Combines airway anti-inflammatory and dual long-acting bronchodilator mechanisms

drug_classes.name: Leukotriene receptor antagonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks cysteinyl-leukotriene-mediated bronchoconstriction/inflammation

drug_classes.name: Methylxanthine bronchodilator
drug_classes.mechanism: Nonselective phosphodiesterase inhibition/adenosine antagonism; narrow therapeutic index

drug_classes.name: Asthma biologic
drug_classes.mechanism: Targets type-2 inflammatory pathways in severe phenotype-selected asthma

drug_classes.name: Second-generation H1 antihistamine
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks peripheral histamine H1 receptors

drug_classes.name: Intranasal corticosteroid
drug_classes.mechanism: Suppresses local nasal inflammatory gene expression

drug_classes.name: Sympathomimetic nasal decongestant
drug_classes.mechanism: Alpha-adrenergic vasoconstriction reduces nasal mucosal edema

drug_classes.name: Centrally acting antitussive
drug_classes.mechanism: Suppresses cough reflex through central sigma/NMDA-related actions

drug_classes.name: Mucolytic/expectorant
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces mucus viscosity or alters mucus secretion

drug_classes.name: Proton-pump inhibitor (PPI)
drug_classes.mechanism: Irreversibly inhibits gastric parietal-cell H+/K+ ATPase

drug_classes.name: H2 receptor antagonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks histamine-stimulated gastric acid secretion

drug_classes.name: Antacid/alginate
drug_classes.mechanism: Neutralizes gastric acid and/or forms a reflux barrier

drug_classes.name: Prokinetic
drug_classes.mechanism: Enhances upper-GI motility through dopamine antagonism and/or serotonergic mechanisms

drug_classes.name: 5-HT3 receptor antagonist antiemetic
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks serotonin 5-HT3 signaling in gut/vagal/CNS pathways

drug_classes.name: Dopamine antagonist antiemetic
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks dopamine D2 pathways involved in emesis

drug_classes.name: Oral rehydration solution
drug_classes.mechanism: Replaces water/electrolytes via coupled intestinal sodium-glucose absorption

drug_classes.name: Peripheral opioid antidiarrheal
drug_classes.mechanism: Slows intestinal motility and secretion

drug_classes.name: Bulk-forming laxative
drug_classes.mechanism: Absorbs water and increases stool bulk

drug_classes.name: Osmotic laxative
drug_classes.mechanism: Retains water in intestinal lumen to soften/increase stool

drug_classes.name: Stimulant laxative
drug_classes.mechanism: Stimulates colonic motility and secretion

drug_classes.name: Intestinal secretagogue
drug_classes.mechanism: Increases intestinal chloride/bicarbonate secretion and transit

drug_classes.name: 5-aminosalicylate
drug_classes.mechanism: Topical anti-inflammatory action in colonic mucosa

drug_classes.name: Gut-selective/systemic corticosteroid for IBD
drug_classes.mechanism: Glucocorticoid anti-inflammatory effects; selected formulations act locally in gut

drug_classes.name: Thiopurine immunomodulator
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits purine metabolism and lymphocyte proliferation

drug_classes.name: Anti-integrin biologic
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks lymphocyte trafficking to gut

drug_classes.name: IL-12/23 pathway biologic
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks p40 subunit shared by IL-12 and IL-23

drug_classes.name: Pancreatic enzyme replacement
drug_classes.mechanism: Provides lipase/protease/amylase to improve digestion

drug_classes.name: Hydrophilic bile acid
drug_classes.mechanism: Alters bile-acid pool and improves bile flow

drug_classes.name: Poorly absorbed intestinal rifamycin
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial RNA polymerase with predominantly intraluminal exposure

drug_classes.name: HBV nucleos(t)ide analogue
drug_classes.mechanism: Suppresses HBV reverse transcription/DNA polymerase

drug_classes.name: Direct-acting antiviral combination for HCV
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits HCV replication proteins such as NS5A/NS5B/protease

drug_classes.name: Aminopenicillins
drug_classes.mechanism: Cell-wall synthesis inhibition via PBPs
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Broader than natural penicillins; beta-lactamase susceptibility limits many organisms.

drug_classes.name: Beta-lactam + beta-lactamase inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Cell-wall inhibition plus beta-lactamase inhibition

drug_classes.name: First-generation cephalosporins
drug_classes.mechanism: Cephalosporin PBP inhibition
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Strong Gram-positive activity with limited Enterobacterales coverage; no Enterococcus.

drug_classes.name: Second-generation cephalosporins / cephamycins
drug_classes.mechanism: Cephalosporin PBP inhibition
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Second-generation spectrum varies; cephamycins add anaerobic activity.

drug_classes.name: Third-generation cephalosporins
drug_classes.mechanism: Cephalosporin PBP inhibition
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Expanded Gram-negative activity; ceftazidime is antipseudomonal while oral agents differ substantially.

drug_classes.name: Fourth/fifth-generation cephalosporins
drug_classes.mechanism: Advanced cephalosporin PBP inhibition
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Cefepime provides antipseudomonal coverage; anti-MRSA activity is specific to agents such as ceftaroline/ceftobiprole.

drug_classes.name: Carbapenems
drug_classes.mechanism: Broad beta-lactam PBP inhibition with stability to many beta-lactamases
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Very broad beta-lactams; ertapenem lacks reliable Pseudomonas/Acinetobacter activity.

drug_classes.name: Macrolides
drug_classes.mechanism: Binds 50S ribosome and inhibits translocation
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Useful atypical/respiratory coverage; pneumococcal/macrolide resistance is common in many settings.

drug_classes.name: Tetracyclines
drug_classes.mechanism: Reversible 30S binding blocks aminoacyl-tRNA attachment
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Broad intracellular/atypical and selected community Gram-positive activity; susceptibility varies.

drug_classes.name: Fluoroquinolones
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits DNA gyrase and topoisomerase IV
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Spectrum differs by agent; resistance and safety warnings require stewardship.

drug_classes.name: Aminoglycosides
drug_classes.mechanism: Irreversible 30S binding causes misreading and bactericidal protein-synthesis disruption
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Concentration-dependent aerobic Gram-negative activity; no anaerobic activity; renal/ototoxicity monitoring is important.

drug_classes.name: Glycopeptide antibiotics
drug_classes.mechanism: Binds D-Ala-D-Ala and blocks peptidoglycan assembly
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Gram-positive only; oral vancomycin acts locally in the gut for C. difficile.

drug_classes.name: Oxazolidinones
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks formation of the 50S initiation complex
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Potent resistant Gram-positive activity; hematologic/serotonergic/neuropathy monitoring is duration-dependent.

drug_classes.name: Lincosamides
drug_classes.mechanism: 50S ribosomal inhibition
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Covers many Gram-positive cocci and anaerobes above the diaphragm; C. difficile risk is important.

drug_classes.name: Folate-pathway inhibitors
drug_classes.mechanism: Sequential folate-pathway inhibition (when trimethoprim + sulfonamide combined)
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Co-trimoxazole has useful community MRSA and Stenotrophomonas activity when susceptible.

drug_classes.name: Urinary-focused antibacterials
drug_classes.mechanism: Mechanism varies; high urinary exposure is central to use
drug_classes.target: Urinary tract / bacterial enzymes or cell processes
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Lower-UTI focused agents; tissue penetration and renal-function limits differ by drug.

drug_classes.name: Nitroimidazoles
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduced metabolites damage DNA in anaerobic organisms
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Strong anaerobic activity below diaphragm; no meaningful aerobic bacterial activity.

drug_classes.name: First-line antitubercular therapy
drug_classes.mechanism: Multi-target combination suppresses and eradicates Mycobacterium tuberculosis while preventing resistance
drug_classes.target: Mycolic acid / RNA polymerase / energy metabolism / arabinogalactan

drug_classes.name: Systemic azole antifungal
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits fungal ergosterol synthesis through CYP51

drug_classes.name: Echinocandin antifungal
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits beta-1,3-D-glucan synthesis in fungal cell wall

drug_classes.name: Polyene antifungal
drug_classes.mechanism: Binds ergosterol and disrupts fungal cell membrane

drug_classes.name: Anti-herpes nucleoside analogue
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits viral DNA polymerase after activation in infected cells

drug_classes.name: Influenza neuraminidase inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks release of progeny influenza virions

drug_classes.name: HIV nucleos(t)ide reverse-transcriptase inhibitor backbone
drug_classes.mechanism: Terminates viral DNA synthesis

drug_classes.name: HIV integrase strand-transfer inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks integration of viral DNA into host genome

drug_classes.name: Artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT)
drug_classes.mechanism: Rapid parasite killing by artemisinin derivative plus longer-acting partner drug

drug_classes.name: Antihelminthic
drug_classes.mechanism: Disrupts parasite microtubules or neuromuscular function

drug_classes.name: Topical scabicide
drug_classes.mechanism: Disrupts mite neuronal sodium-channel function

drug_classes.name: Non-opioid analgesic/antipyretic
drug_classes.mechanism: Central analgesic/antipyretic actions with minimal peripheral anti-inflammatory effect

drug_classes.name: Systemic NSAID
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits cyclooxygenase and prostaglandin synthesis

drug_classes.name: Topical NSAID
drug_classes.mechanism: Local cyclooxygenase inhibition with lower systemic exposure

drug_classes.name: Weak opioid / mixed analgesic
drug_classes.mechanism: Opioid receptor agonism with additional monoaminergic effects for some agents

drug_classes.name: Strong opioid
drug_classes.mechanism: μ-opioid receptor agonism producing analgesia and respiratory/CNS effects

drug_classes.name: Centrally acting skeletal-muscle relaxant
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces spinal/central muscle spasm signaling; mechanism varies by agent

drug_classes.name: Gabapentinoid
drug_classes.mechanism: Binds alpha2-delta subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels, reducing excitatory neurotransmitter release

drug_classes.name: SNRI with pain indication
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits serotonin and norepinephrine reuptake, enhancing descending pain inhibition

drug_classes.name: Tricyclic antidepressant / neuropathic analgesic
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits serotonin/norepinephrine reuptake with anticholinergic and sodium-channel effects

drug_classes.name: Triptan
drug_classes.mechanism: Cranial vasoconstriction and trigeminal neuropeptide inhibition

drug_classes.name: CGRP receptor antagonist (gepant)
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks calcitonin gene-related peptide signaling involved in migraine

drug_classes.name: CGRP-pathway monoclonal antibody
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks CGRP ligand or receptor to prevent migraine

drug_classes.name: Colchicine
drug_classes.mechanism: Disrupts microtubule polymerization and neutrophil inflammatory responses

drug_classes.name: Xanthine oxidase inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces uric-acid synthesis

drug_classes.name: Bisphosphonate
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits osteoclast-mediated bone resorption
drug_classes.target: Bone hydroxyapatite / osteoclast farnesyl pyrophosphate synthase

drug_classes.name: RANKL inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Suppresses osteoclast formation/function by blocking RANKL

drug_classes.name: Conventional synthetic DMARD
drug_classes.mechanism: Modifies immune/inflammatory pathways to control inflammatory arthritis

drug_classes.name: TNF inhibitor biologic
drug_classes.mechanism: Neutralizes tumor necrosis factor signaling

drug_classes.name: JAK inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks Janus kinase signaling downstream of multiple cytokines

drug_classes.name: Selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI)
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits serotonin transporter and increases synaptic serotonin

drug_classes.name: Atypical antidepressant
drug_classes.mechanism: Mechanism varies: norepinephrine/dopamine reuptake inhibition or alpha2/serotonin receptor modulation

drug_classes.name: Benzodiazepine
drug_classes.mechanism: Positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptors

drug_classes.name: Z-drug hypnotic
drug_classes.mechanism: Positive allosteric modulation of GABA-A receptor subtypes

drug_classes.name: Second-generation antipsychotic
drug_classes.mechanism: Dopamine/serotonin receptor modulation; profile differs by agent

drug_classes.name: First-generation antipsychotic
drug_classes.mechanism: Potent dopamine D2 receptor antagonism

drug_classes.name: Lithium mood stabilizer
drug_classes.mechanism: Modulates intracellular second-messenger and glycogen-synthase-kinase pathways

drug_classes.name: Valproate antiseizure/mood stabilizer
drug_classes.mechanism: Enhances GABA and affects sodium/calcium channels

drug_classes.name: Lamotrigine
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks voltage-gated sodium channels and reduces glutamate release

drug_classes.name: Levetiracetam-class antiseizure drug
drug_classes.mechanism: Modulates synaptic vesicle release

drug_classes.name: Sodium-channel antiseizure drug
drug_classes.mechanism: Stabilizes inactivated voltage-gated sodium channels and reduces repetitive firing

drug_classes.name: Topiramate
drug_classes.mechanism: Multiple antiseizure effects including sodium-channel block, GABA enhancement and AMPA inhibition

drug_classes.name: Levodopa + dopa-decarboxylase inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Restores CNS dopamine precursor while reducing peripheral levodopa metabolism

drug_classes.name: Dopamine agonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Directly stimulates dopamine receptors

drug_classes.name: MAO-B inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces dopamine breakdown in the CNS

drug_classes.name: Acetylcholinesterase inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Increases synaptic acetylcholine in CNS

drug_classes.name: NMDA receptor antagonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces pathologic glutamatergic excitotoxic signaling

drug_classes.name: Uroselective alpha-1 blocker
drug_classes.mechanism: Relaxes prostate/bladder-neck smooth muscle

drug_classes.name: 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces conversion of testosterone to dihydrotestosterone and prostate volume over months

drug_classes.name: PDE5 inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Enhances nitric-oxide/cGMP signaling in smooth muscle

drug_classes.name: Bladder antimuscarinic
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces detrusor overactivity

drug_classes.name: Beta-3 bladder agonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Relaxes detrusor during storage phase

drug_classes.name: Oral iron replacement
drug_classes.mechanism: Provides elemental iron for hemoglobin synthesis and iron-store repletion

drug_classes.name: Intravenous iron
drug_classes.mechanism: Replenishes iron stores parenterally

drug_classes.name: Vitamin B12 replacement
drug_classes.mechanism: Restores cobalamin-dependent DNA and neurologic metabolism

drug_classes.name: Folate replacement
drug_classes.mechanism: Restores folate-dependent one-carbon metabolism and DNA synthesis

drug_classes.name: Erythropoiesis-stimulating agent
drug_classes.mechanism: Activates erythropoietin receptor to stimulate red-cell production

drug_classes.name: Phosphate binder
drug_classes.mechanism: Binds dietary phosphate in gut to reduce absorption

drug_classes.name: Calcimimetic
drug_classes.mechanism: Allosterically activates calcium-sensing receptor and reduces PTH secretion

drug_classes.name: Potassium binder
drug_classes.mechanism: Exchanges ions in gut to increase fecal potassium removal

drug_classes.name: Topical corticosteroid
drug_classes.mechanism: Local glucocorticoid anti-inflammatory effect

drug_classes.name: Topical calcineurin inhibitor
drug_classes.mechanism: Suppresses T-cell cytokine activation without steroid atrophy

drug_classes.name: Topical antifungal
drug_classes.mechanism: Disrupts fungal ergosterol synthesis or squalene metabolism

drug_classes.name: Oral allylamine antifungal
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits fungal squalene epoxidase

drug_classes.name: Topical acne retinoid / benzoyl peroxide
drug_classes.mechanism: Normalizes follicular keratinization and/or produces antibacterial oxidant effect

drug_classes.name: Topical antibiotic for acne
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial 50S protein synthesis locally

drug_classes.name: Systemic retinoid
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces sebaceous gland size/sebum and normalizes follicular keratinization

drug_classes.name: Combined estrogen-progestin contraceptive
drug_classes.mechanism: Suppresses ovulation and alters cervical/endometrial physiology

drug_classes.name: Progestin therapy
drug_classes.mechanism: Progestational suppression of endometrium/ovulation depending regimen

drug_classes.name: Antifibrinolytic
drug_classes.mechanism: Blocks plasminogen binding and reduces fibrin breakdown

drug_classes.name: Ovulation-induction agent
drug_classes.mechanism: Modulates estrogen feedback or aromatization to induce follicular development

drug_classes.name: Prostaglandin analogue eye drop
drug_classes.mechanism: Increases uveoscleral aqueous outflow

drug_classes.name: Ophthalmic beta blocker
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces aqueous humor production

drug_classes.name: Carbonic anhydrase inhibitor eye drop
drug_classes.mechanism: Reduces aqueous humor production

drug_classes.name: Ocular lubricant
drug_classes.mechanism: Supplements tear film and reduces surface friction

drug_classes.name: Topical ophthalmic antibiotic
drug_classes.mechanism: Local bacterial protein/DNA/cell-wall inhibition depending agent

drug_classes.name: Topical otic antibiotic
drug_classes.mechanism: Local antibacterial activity in ear canal

drug_classes.name: IM epinephrine for anaphylaxis
drug_classes.mechanism: Alpha/beta adrenergic agonism reverses vasodilation, edema and bronchospasm

drug_classes.name: Opioid antagonist
drug_classes.mechanism: Competitive opioid-receptor antagonism reverses opioid respiratory/CNS depression

drug_classes.name: Natural penicillins
drug_classes.mechanism: Cell-wall synthesis inhibition via PBPs
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Classic narrow-spectrum beta-lactams; activity depends on organism and beta-lactamase production.

drug_classes.name: Anti-staphylococcal penicillins
drug_classes.mechanism: Cell-wall synthesis inhibition; penicillinase-stable
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Designed for penicillinase-producing MSSA; not MRSA.

drug_classes.name: Antipseudomonal penicillins
drug_classes.mechanism: Extended-spectrum PBP inhibition
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Antipseudomonal activity is agent- and susceptibility-dependent; usually used with a beta-lactamase inhibitor in modern practice.

drug_classes.name: Beta-lactam + beta-lactamase inhibitor combinations
drug_classes.mechanism: PBP inhibition plus beta-lactamase inhibition
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Spectrum varies markedly by beta-lactam and inhibitor; resistant phenotypes require organism-specific guidance.

drug_classes.name: Advanced cephalosporin + beta-lactamase inhibitor combinations
drug_classes.mechanism: PBP inhibition plus advanced beta-lactamase inhibition
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Designed for selected resistant Gram-negative phenotypes; exact enzyme spectrum differs by inhibitor.

drug_classes.name: Siderophore cephalosporin
drug_classes.mechanism: Iron-transport facilitated entry plus PBP inhibition
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Reserve-oriented Gram-negative agent; susceptibility testing and current guidance are essential.

drug_classes.name: Carbapenem + beta-lactamase inhibitor combinations
drug_classes.mechanism: Carbapenem PBP inhibition plus inhibitor activity against selected carbapenemases
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Specialist therapy for selected resistant Gram-negative infections; enzyme type and AST matter.

drug_classes.name: Monobactams
drug_classes.mechanism: Gram-negative PBP inhibition
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Aerobic Gram-negative activity; lacks Gram-positive and anaerobic activity.

drug_classes.name: Lipoglycopeptides
drug_classes.mechanism: Glycopeptide cell-wall inhibition plus membrane effects
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Long-acting Gram-positive agents; indications and Enterococcus activity vary by agent.

drug_classes.name: Cyclic lipopeptide
drug_classes.mechanism: Membrane insertion and rapid depolarization
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Daptomycin is not used for pneumonia because pulmonary surfactant inactivates activity.

drug_classes.name: Glycylcycline / newer tetracycline derivatives
drug_classes.mechanism: 30S inhibition with structural modifications that overcome selected resistance mechanisms
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Broad agents with important exclusions; tigecycline/eravacycline do not cover Pseudomonas.

drug_classes.name: Streptogramins
drug_classes.mechanism: Dual binding to 50S ribosome
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Specialist Gram-positive therapy; VRE activity mainly relates to E. faecium, not E. faecalis.

drug_classes.name: Phenicols
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits peptidyl transferase on 50S
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Broad historical agent limited by serious hematologic toxicity and safer alternatives.

drug_classes.name: Systemic rifamycins
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits DNA-dependent RNA polymerase
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Resistance develops rapidly with monotherapy for many organisms; major drug interactions occur via enzyme induction.

drug_classes.name: Polymyxins
drug_classes.mechanism: Disrupts Gram-negative outer/cytoplasmic membranes via LPS binding
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Last-line/reserve Gram-negative agents with nephro/neurotoxicity; intrinsic resistance occurs in several species.

drug_classes.name: Pleuromutilins
drug_classes.mechanism: Binds 50S peptidyl transferase center
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Systemic lefamulin is respiratory-focused; retapamulin is topical.

drug_classes.name: C. difficile-focused macrocyclic antibiotic
drug_classes.mechanism: Inhibits bacterial RNA polymerase at a distinct site
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Fidaxomicin has minimal systemic absorption and is focused on C. difficile infection.

drug_classes.name: Topical/local antibacterials
drug_classes.mechanism: Local antibacterial mechanisms vary by agent
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Local-use agents; avoid treating deep/systemic infection with topical therapy alone.

drug_classes.name: Aminocyclitol antibacterial
drug_classes.mechanism: Binds 30S ribosome and inhibits translocation
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Legacy/region-dependent gonococcal option where available; current STI guidance should be checked.

drug_classes.name: Amidinopenicillins (mecillinam / pivmecillinam)
drug_classes.mechanism: Selective PBP2 inhibition in Enterobacterales
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Urinary Enterobacterales-focused beta-lactam class; availability and dosing vary by country.

drug_classes.name: Temocillin
drug_classes.mechanism: Beta-lactam PBP inhibition with stability to many ESBL/AmpC enzymes
drug_classes.spectrum_note: Narrower resistant Enterobacterales-focused agent used mainly in selected regions; lacks Pseudomonas activity.

brand_companies_note: V5.00 is generic-first. Manufacturer/pharma promotional pages are not evidence-ranking sources. When manufacturer information is needed, use regulator-approved prescribing information / SmPC / package insert and verify current version.
coverage_note: MTLPI v2.4N retains the core disease/generic atlas and all earlier specialized pharmacology labs, adding a dedicated Endocrinology • Hormone • Metabolic Intelligence Lab for adrenal, pituitary, gonadal, obesity and parathyroid pharmacology. Research/learning CDS only; patient-specific safety verification remains mandatory. V5.40P adds a dedicated immunization/preventive-medicine lab through the specialized pharmacology dataset. V5.40Q adds a dedicated TB/leprosy/NTM mycobacterial pharmacology lab through the specialized dataset. V5.40R adds dedicated high-risk critical-care/ICU pharmacology through the specialized dataset. V5.40S adds transplant immunosuppression, rejection, TDM and opportunistic-infection pharmacology through the specialized dataset. V5.40T adds a dedicated geriatrics/polypharmacy/deprescribing/frailty medication-safety lab through the specialized pharmacology dataset. V5.40U adds a cross-cutting Pregnancy/Lactation/Reproductive Safety lab using PLLR/LactMed-centered verification and product-specific contraception/washout safeguards.
